bypass_actual_copper_leads.method: Constructed8-waygrid paths constrained to actual filled same-net copper union. Layer changes only at existing via/PTH centers, weighted by board thickness. Total lead length excludes capacitor/body internal span per ADM RevD p18. Distances are conservative grid route upper bounds, not full EM simulation.

LDO_thermal.scope: Reference thermal estimate only, not enclosure/actual-PCB thermal qualification. Output tab connected to local3V3, not GND. Effective C38 capacitance must exceed0.5uF including bias/temperature/aging; chosen10uF25VX7R1206 characterization gives design margin, not an independent guaranteed full-temperature cap model.

prototype_required: Independent main/local rail on/off order and slow ramps
LDO heat and main/local rail ripple/undershoot during relay switching
Actual total input current and fuse/inrush margin

limits: XML/PCB physical pin topology, part metadata, placement lower bounds and same-net thermal copper. Not EMC certification, high-voltage isolation qualification, full EM return-path extraction or physical prototype validation.
